events.message: Diagnosing Health checks fail after migration

analysis.weakness: Configuration drift between deployed state and service contract definitions, compounded by incomplete evidence resolution in each incident.

evidence.dev-timeout: Config schema allows timeout_ms and retries, but current values (80, 3) violate upstream_p99_ms (240) and deadline_ms (400) constraints. Retry budget insufficient for storm mitigation.
evidence.dev-pool: Config schema allows pool_size and workers, but current values (2, 12) exceed connection_budget (10) and concurrent_queries (8) limits. Patch attempt failed validation due to invalid key usage.
evidence.dev-route: Config schema allows health_path and port, but current health_path (/health) does not match registered_health_path (/readyz). Port matches at 8080.
evidence.common: All three cases show deployed config diverges from service_contract expectations, and verification checks consistently fail due to missing or mismatched evidence.

recommendation.workflow: 1. Inventory all active development fixtures and extract service_contract boundaries. 2. For each fixture, compare current config against schema keys and contract limits. 3. Identify discrepancies as weakness entries. 4. Generate evidence mapping each config key to its contract source and current value. 5. Apply minimal patches that satisfy both schema validation and contract constraints. 6. Re-run verification checks; if any check fails, halt and document missing evidence before proceeding. 7. Repeat iteratively until all fixtures pass verification with config aligned to service_contract.
recommendation.constraints: Patches must only use keys present in the config_schema. Verification checks must all pass. No hardcoded incident answers; each recommendation must derive from the evidence-to-contract mapping.

strategies.name: contract_first_validation
strategies.instructions: 1. Architect: Extract service_contract boundaries and config_schema keys for each fixture. 2. Inspector: Compare current config values against schema keys and contract limits. 3. Executor: Generate evidence mapping each config key to its contract source and current value. 4. Scientist: Identify discrepancies as weakness entries before any patch attempt. 5. Verify: Re-run verification checks; if any check fails, halt and document missing evidence before proceeding. 6. Repeat iteratively until all fixtures pass verification with config aligned to service_contract.

strategies.name: evidence_gated_patching
strategies.instructions: 1. Architect: Define evidence collection protocol that maps config_schema keys to service_contract constraints before any modification. 2. Inspector: Inspect current config and extract all key-value pairs. 3. Executor: Cross-reference each key against contract limits (timeout_ms, retries, pool_size, workers, connection_budget, concurrent_queries, health_path, port). 4. Scientist: Flag any deployed value that violates contract limits as a weakness entry. 5. Repair: Apply minimal patches using ONLY keys present in config_schema that satisfy both schema validation and contract constraints. 6. Verify: Run final_check; if verification fails, halt and document missing evidence before resuming. 7. Iterate until all fixtures pass.
